title: YHN Acquisition I Ltd 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: YHN Acquisition I Limited, a SPAC listed on Nasdaq under symbols YHNA/YHNAU/YHNAR, received two Nasdaq deficiency notices on April 17, 2026 for failure to meet listing standards: the minimum Market Value of Publicly Held Shares (MVPHS) requirement of $15,000,000 and the minimum Market Value of Listed Securities (MVLS) requirement of $50,000,000. Both violations persisted for 30 consecutive business days from March 5 through April 16, 2026. The company has until October 14, 2026 to regain compliance or transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market.
key_points: Nasdaq deficiency notice received April 17, 2026 for MVPHS non-compliance (requirement: $15,000,000 minimum)
Nasdaq deficiency notice received April 17, 2026 for MVLS non-compliance (requirement: $50,000,000 minimum)
Non-compliance period: 30 consecutive business days from March 5, 2026 to April 16, 2026
Compliance deadline: October 14, 2026 (180 calendar days per Nasdaq Rule 5810)
Alternative option: transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market with continued listing requirements
No immediate effect on listing or trading as of April 20, 2026; YHNA continues trading on Nasdaq
